title: Shinonome Ena — Creating Something Worth Seeing〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It still doesn't feel right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The draft of Kanade's next song had this clarity or transparency to it, which gave it this really gentle feel...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I need to find a way to make this girl's face reflect that. It needs to exude gentleness and kindness somehow...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh...! But I can't figure out how!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
It's happening again...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have this perfect picture of what to draw in my head, but it's like the more I draw, the more I deviate from it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm starting to lose focus too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I think I'll log onto Nightcord.
It's a little early, but Kanade should be there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hello?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Hello.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, Yuki, you're here.
Wait, is it just you?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K was here until just now, but went to get food.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. How about Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Amia should be back soon.
K said, “Amia's taking a bath.”>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, okay.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <If that's all, I'll be muting myself.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Be my guest. I logged on to take a quick break, so I'll be back at it soon.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, going on mute.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've gotten pretty used to talking to Mafuyu in her current state too.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Now that I know what she's been through, I sort of have to rethink what my boundaries are...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At the same time, I'm more used to the curt and blunt version of her as opposed to the polite honor student.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe actually seeing and talking to Mafuyu in person is why I feel this way...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But she also turned out to be OWN.
Talk about a shocker...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (However, based on what Kanade said, the first song Mafuyu ever made was her arrangement of one of Kanade's old songs.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She essentially had zero musical knowledge, made her own version of a song and ended up becoming OWN.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That might just be a testament to her having all this latent talent hidden away until now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My mom asked me what I wanted as a graduation gift but didn't have an immediate answer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But what made me pause was hearing how, “Nothing's going to change...”>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That gave me the impression that I'd have to live each day feeling nothing at all during high school, university and even beyond that...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K's song made me think otherwise...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She talked about that like it was just a matter of fact...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I can't help but wonder if a part of her was trying to break free of all that. I mean, she went through the trouble of making her own version of Kanade's song...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Breaking free...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is that why her music as OWN hit me so hard?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The first song Yuki posted definitely felt a bit rough around the edges...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But it also made things so clear.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<A world of nothing but pure despair...
Or rather, it's desperately empty...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's likely why I was compelled to try and cast some light on it with another song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(So Kanade says...
What was Mafuyu's first song like?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can I ask you a question, Yuki...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad she still had it saved.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It probably would've bugged me to no end and kept me from finishing this illustration if I didn't ask.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, let's give it a listen...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Kanade was right...
This sounds so amateur compared to what she can do now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(How do I describe this feeling...?
It's like I'm being frozen from the inside...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is this that “emptiness” she was talking about? Is this what she wanted to cast a light on...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Light...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She was my light that time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway!
I need to get back to work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thanks for sharing that with me, Yuki. It'll help a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You're welcome.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, this thing needs to have more clarity, but also feels kind and gentle because of it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to figure out a way to match the theme of Kanade's song better.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And right now, this isn't doing it any justice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's time for an overhaul.
There has to be a better way of illustrating what's going on with this song!
